availability: All selected supported input cutoffs must return available or explicitly infeasible; unavailable is an acceptance failure and remains reported.
mean_error_denominator_j: max(3600000, 0.10 * remaining_reference_battery_draw_j) per cutoff, then arithmetic mean within trip and equal trip weight
reserve_definition: Minimum reference SOC over every 0.2-working-second plant step in the remaining horizon, including the cutoff and endpoint, below vehicle reserve minus 1e-6 while prediction minimum SOC >= reserve and motion feasible
baseline: Previous 30 working seconds net energy per traveled meter multiplied by remaining assigned road distance; unavailable before 30 seconds or when distance < 1 meter; never use future realized distance, energy or speed. Common-cutoff MAE is cutoff-weighted and reported separately from trip-balanced acceptance metrics.
cutoffs: First eligible recorded state at or after departure, 30, 60, 120 working seconds and 25%, 50%, 75% elapsed trip time. Junction states and SUMO stop-entry steps with residual speed are ineligible. Fractional cutoff selection is evaluation-only and conveys no future duration to the worker.
claim_scope: Nine synthetic route families with declared vehicle/equipment inputs. Neither real-vehicle accuracy nor unobserved future traffic/weather is established. Wind, equipment details, scenario restrictions, and battery curves have separate factor/domain tests.
